about: Night map data per room design (read by web/fx-nightmap.mjs; the pictures <design>-mon.png and <design>-rim.png are drawn from it by scripts/make-nightmap.mjs). Coordinates are in the desk picture as drawn in objects.png, measured from the top-left of the kind's rect. monitors.<design>.<desk kind>: box = the area that holds the monitor (back, neck and foot), seed = a pixel of the monitor's back, screen = the back of the screen [x0, y0, x1, y1] (its centre is where the pool is pulled towards). lamps are for the lamp variant (next stage).
